bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'HOST_ALIVE=YES\n'
printf 'TARGET_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
printf 'BOT_RUNNING=%s\n' "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null || printf UNKNOWN)"
printf 'BOT_IMAGE=%s\n' "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Config.Image}}' 2>/dev/null || printf UNKNOWN)"
printf 'OLD_INPLACE_REQUEST=UNVERIFIED_REQUIRES_WRITER_LEDGER_READBACK\n'
